text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penyemakan Undang-Undang
(Pembetulan Kanun Tatacara Jenayah) 2018.

Pembetulan

2, Cetakan semula Kanun Tatacara Jenayah (Akta 593] yang disiarkan dalam

tahun 2012 yang mengandungi segala pindaan hingga 1 November 2012
dibetulkan —

(a) dalam Jadual Pertama dalam butiran yang berhubungan dengan—

(i) seksyen 292 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
menggantikan perkataan "Sale, efc., of obscene objects to
young person" dengan perkataan "Having in possession obscene
books, etc., for sale or exhibition";

PU. (A) 238.                             2422

(ii) seksyen 293 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
menggantikan perkataan "Having in possession obscene books,
etc,, for sale or exhibition" dengan perkataan "Sale, etc., of
obscene objects to young person";

(iii) seksyen 431A Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
memasukkan koma selepas perkataan "cable";

(iv) seksyen 450 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
menggantikan perkataan "penal servitude" dengan perkataan
"imprisonment";

(v

—

seksyen 477 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
memasukkan selepas perkataan "attempting" perkataan "to";

(vi) seksyen 4898 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
memasukkan selepas perkataan "forged" perkataan "or";

(vii) seksyen 493 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
menggantikan perkataan "co-habit" dengan perkataan "cohabit";

(viii) seksyen 501 Kanun Keseksaan, dalam ruang 2, dengan
menggantikan perkataan "and" dengan perkataan "or"; dan

(b) dalam "LIST OF SECTIONS AMENDED", dengan menggantikan

perkataan "M.U. Ord. 13/1957" yang terdapat dalam "First Schedule"
dengan perkataan "M.U. Ord. 13/1947".

Dibuat 20 September 2018
[PN(SU.2)1/rep/613 Jld 4; PN(PU)231/IV]

Dato' Siti ZAWAHIR BINTI MOHAMED
Pesuruhjaya Penyemak Undang-Undang Malaysia

REVISION OF LAWS ACT 1968

REVISION OF LAWS (RECTIFICATION OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE
Cope) ORDER 2018

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the Revision of Laws Act
1968 [Act 1], the Commissioner of Law Revision makes the following order:

Citation

1, This order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Rectification of
Criminal Procedure Code) Order 2018.

2423                P.U. (A) 238.

LLL LLL At

Rectification

2. The reprint of the Criminal Procedure Code [Act 593] published in the
year 2012 incorporating all amendments up to 1 November 2012 is rectified —

(a) in the First Schedule in the item relating to—

(i) section 292 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by substituting
for the words "Sale, etc., of obscene objects to young
person" the words "Having in possession obscene books, éfc.,
for sale or exhibition";

(ii) section 293 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by substituting
for the words "Having in possession obscene books, efc.,
for sale or exhibition" the words "Sale, etc., of obscene
objects to young person";

(iii) section 4314 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by inserting a
comma after the word "cable";

(iv) section 450 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by substituting
for the words "penal servitude" the word "imprisonment";

(v) section 477 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by inserting after
the word "attempting" the word "to";

(vi) section 489s of the Penal Code, in column 2, by inserting after
the word "forged" the word "or";

(vii) section 493 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by substituting
for the word "co-habit" the word "cohabit";

(viii) section 501 of the Penal Code, in column 2, by substituting
for the word "and" the word "or"; and

(b) in the "LIST OF SECTIONS AMENDED", by substituting for the
words "M.U. Ord. 13/1957" appearing in "First Schedule" the words
"M.U. Ord. 13/1947".

Made 20 September 2018
[PN(SU.2)1/rep/613 Jld 4; PN(PU2)231/IV]

Dato' Siti ZAWAHIR BINTI MOHAMED
Commissioner of Law Revision Malaysia
